responsibility: Implements AVR’s common target policy for defaults and option validation, especially for floating-point type configuration. It overrides several generic optimization assumptions that are inappropriate for AVR code generation, chooses configured defaults for double and long double sizes, forces SJLJ unwinding, and checks -mdouble= and -mlong-double= against the compiler’s configured multilib capabilities while synchronizing the related gcc_options fields used by the rest of the AVR backend.
